text:
Mia Chen: Heads-up — I'm opening a PR to wire the signing key rotation for the prod kustomize overlay. We discovered the current secret mount uses a static file path that breaks when we rotate keys via KMS. Need a quick cfg review before I flip the gating rule.

Ravi Patel: link? I'll skim.

Mia Chen: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infrastructure/pull/3124 — main changes: terraform adds kms_crypto_key_member for the signer service account, overlay/prod adds a projected volume from the external-secrets sidecar, and release-gate CI now checks that the secret path exists before promote.

Jen Ortiz: quick Q — why projected volume versus explicit secret? Is ExternalSecrets enabled in prod clusters now?

Mia Chen: Yes, ExternalSecrets is running in prod. Projected volume lets the sidecar rotate the file atomically. Avoids brief missing-file windows during kubernetes secret replace.

Leo Zhang: snippet of the TF addition? paste here so SRE can eyeball IAM scope.

Mia Chen: ```terraform
resource "google_project_iam_member" "kms_signer_sa" {
  project = var.project_id
  role    = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
  member  = "serviceAccount:signer-sa@${var.project_id}.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
  depends_on = [google_kms_crypto_key.signing_key]
}
```

Ravi Patel: +1 on role but prefer cryptoKeySignerVerifier on the key if we only need signing. Are we using asymmetric keys or symmetric?

Mia Chen: asymmetric, RSA_SIGN_PKCS1_2048_SHA256. I updated the KMS key resource.

Jen Ortiz: For the kustomize overlay change, can you include a small healthcheck probe that fails fast if the projected file is missing? Helps release-gate detect miswiring.

Mia Chen: Good call — added an initContainer to check file exists and `read` it. Example:```yaml
initContainers:
  - name: check-sign-key
    image: busybox
    command: ["/bin/sh","-c","[ -s /etc/signer/key.pem ] || exit 1"]
    volumeMounts:
      - name: signer-key
        mountPath: /etc/signer
```

Leo Zhang: CI gating change — what does the pipeline look for now? I want to ensure no false positives block deploys.

Mia Chen: The release pipeline (release/gate.yaml) now runs `kubectl apply -k overlays/staging --dry-run=server` and an extra step that `kubectl exec` into a staging pod to verify the file is present before promoting. For prod promote we require that staging passed within the last 24h.

Ravi Patel: Can we relax that to 7 days? Some infra-only PRs don't get run daily. Also what about Canary window?

Mia Chen: I set default canary window to 30m and gradual rollouts: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback on pod health failures. We can make the staging freshness a config; default 24h seemed conservative.

Jen Ortiz: Please add a terraform plan output snippet to the PR description so reviewers don't have to run plan locally. Also tag me for LGTM on IAM.

Mia Chen: Will do. Added `terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform show -json tfplan | jq .` output block.

sre-bot: CI alert — staging dry-run succeeded for PR #3124 at 1802346220 :white_check_mark:

Ravi Patel: Quick nit — in overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml, add `replicas: 2` for the signer deployment so rotation doesn't cause complete downtime during rollout.

Mia Chen: Done. Also added `strategy: RollingUpdate` with `maxUnavailable: 1`.

Leo Zhang: I'll eyeball the PR now. If it looks good I can merge and kick off a controlled canary.

Mia Chen: Thanks — ping me if you need to run any manual checks.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: canary rollout for service/signer in prod at 1802346400 (PR #3124). See dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/deploys/3124

Jen Ortiz: Reviewed IAM portion, looks good. @Leo Zhang please merge when ready. :thumbsup:

Leo Zhang: Merged. Will watch the canary and escalate if health dips.

sre-bot: Canary reached 25% at 1802347000 — no errors observed.

Mia Chen: Great, thanks team. Will follow up with a short post-deploy note in eng-infra with the rotation playbook. :memo:
